---
title: "Domain profiles"
---

<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"><a href="../criteria/index.html">Multiple criteria</a><span aria-hidden="true"> → </span><span aria-current="page">Domain profiles</span></nav>

Domain profiles give sites a separate grade for each outcome. A site can rank higher on composition need
and lower on community need. The two grades describe those separate priorities.

[P.1 compares common and separate grades](profile-common-vs-domain.qmd). P.2 considers
[when grades can be chosen separately](profile-separability.qmd), P.3 examines
[errors that overlap across domains](profile-dependence.qmd), and P.4 varies
[the budget for errors across both domains](profile-resolution.qmd).

The first four examples evaluate every candidate under a fully specified fictional distribution.
The [forty-site example](fictional-site-profiles.qmd) shows grades and risk summaries from an earlier
fictional analysis.
